## Experiment

```{r}
library(ggregions)

# Step 1 Prepare reference data set
nc_ref <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package="sf")) |> 
  select(county_name = NAME, 
         county_fips = FIPS, 
         geometry)

nc_cities_ref <- maps::us.cities |> 
  filter(country.etc == "NC") |> 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, " NC")) |> 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), agr = "constant") |> 
  select(name, geometry)

sf::st_crs(nc_cities_ref) <-  "NAD27"
# Step 1 Declare reference data
set_regions(regions = nc_ref, 
            locales = nc_cities_ref)


nc_ref |> 
  bind_rows(nc_cities_ref) |> 
  tail()


ggplot() + 
  stamp_region() +
  ggregions:::stamp_locale_label()
```
